summary: Tested game history & leaderboard feature end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed (save_game, get_games, leaderboard sorting, player-stats aggregation, validation). Frontend: All flows passed via Playwright — setup History button, game Save (success + zero-score guard), View Stats nav, three History tabs render data, winner highlighted in Recent Games, back-to-setup works.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 on resource creation; minor REST convention deviation.
No DELETE/clear endpoint exists, so seeded TEST_ data cannot be cleaned automatically. Test data persists in MongoDB.
No server-side validation that winner is one of players[].name or that players list is non-empty (empty array would cause Math.max issues on client only). Backend accepts any winner string.

action_items: (Optional) Return 201 on POST /api/games per REST convention
(Optional) Validate winner is contained in players list and players list is non-empty on backend
(Optional) Add a cleanup/delete-by-prefix endpoint or a script to clear TEST_ seeded data
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses datetime.isoformat() string when inserting, then converts back to datetime on read — Pydantic Game model will parse string fine, but inconsistent storage type (string vs BSON date) prevents proper date-range queries. Consider storing as native datetime.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager.
Aggregation in /api/leaderboard uses $lookup self-join which is inefficient; could compute wins via $sum {$cond:[{$eq:['$players.name','$winner']},1,0]} after $unwind. Low priority at small scale.
Frontend Math.max(...totals) when totals=[] (no players) would yield -Infinity; not reachable today since setup requires >=1 player, but defensive check would be nice.
GameScreen winner is computed by indexOf(maxScore) which silently picks first player on ties — acceptable but consider noting in UI.
seed_data_creation: Seeded games with players TEST_Alice, TEST_Bob, TEST_Charlie, TEST_UIAlice, TEST_UIBob via test runs. Data persists in MongoDB 'games' collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_game_history.py; run with pytest. All endpoints (/api/games POST/GET, /api/leaderboard, /api/player-stats) verified. UI flow verified: SetupScreen->History (setup-history-btn), GameScreen->Save (btn-save-game with sonner toast), GameScreen->ViewStats (game-view-stats-btn), HistoryScreen tabs (tab-leaderboard, tab-stats, tab-recent), back via history-back-btn. Winner highlighting in Recent Games confirmed visually.
